confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Lima price tiers (Miraflores, Barranco, central Lima). Not checked against live menus, listings, or booking pages. Restaurant, beer and coffee anchors are more reliable than hotel and hostel rates, which vary widely by neighborhood, season and booking channel. Local examples assume roughly 3.6 soles per US dollar; re-check the USD values if the sol has moved materially. Reference window is July 2026.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: large South American capitals with established tourist districts (Bogota, Quito, Santiago). Lima's dining and budget lodging sit toward the lower-middle of that group, and three-star hotel rates follow upscale business-hotel pricing in Miraflores and San Isidro.
